const cfg = { proxy: "127.0.0.1", port: 7897 };
const js = [
  "const http=require('http');",
  "const cfg=" + JSON.stringify(cfg) + ";",
  "const UA='Mozilla/5.0 Chrome/155';",
  "const targets=[",
  "  ['52pojie_home','https://www.52pojie.cn/'],",
  "  ['52pojie_bounty','https://www.52pojie.cn/forum-8-1.html'],",
  "  ['kanxue_home','https://bbs.kanxue.com/']",
  "];",
  "let i=0;",
  "function sleep(ms){return new Promise(function(r){setTimeout(r,ms)});}",
  "async function next(){",
  "  if(i>=targets.length) return;",
  "  const t=targets[i++];",
  "  const pu=new URL(t[1]);",
  "  await sleep(i===1?2000:10000);",
  "  http.get({host:cfg.proxy,port:cfg.port,path:t[1],headers:{Host:pu.host,'User-Agent':UA,'Accept-Language':'zh-CN,zh;q=0.9'}},function(res){",
  "    const c=[];res.on('data',function(d){c.push(d)});",
  "    res.on('end',async function(){",
  "      let b=Buffer.concat(c);",
  "      let s;",
  "      try{ s=new TextDecoder('gbk').decode(b); }catch(e){ s=b.toString('utf8'); }",
  "      s=s.replace(/<script[\\s\\S]*?<\\/script>/g,' ').replace(/<style[\\s\\S]*?<\\/style>/g,' ').replace(/<[^>]+>/g,' ');",
  "      s=s.replace(/ /g,' ').replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/'/g,String.fromCharCode(39)).replace(/"/g,String.fromCharCode(34)).replace(/\\s+/g,' ');",
  "      console.log('===== '+t[0]+' OK '+res.statusCode+' len='+s.length);",
  "      console.log(s.substring(0,3000));",
  "      await next();",
  "    });",
  "  }).on('error',async function(e){console.log('===== '+t[0]+' ERR '+e.message); await next();});",
  "}",
  "next();",
].join("\n");
await tools.write({ file_path: "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-re.cjs", content: js });
const f = "C:/Users/jjq21/AppData/Local/Temp/ofm-re.cjs";
const r = await tools.pwsh({ command: "node " + JSON.stringify(f), description: "Fetch 52pojie and kanxue bounty sections", timeoutMs: 260000 });
console.log(r.kind === "foreground" ? (r.stdout.text + r.stderr.text).slice(0, 10000) : JSON.stringify(r).slice(0, 2000));
